hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */frontend/*.ts|*/frontend/*.tsx|*/frontend/*.js|*/frontend/*.jsx|*/frontend/*.mjs|*/frontend/*.cjs|*/frontend/*.json|*/frontend/*.css|*/frontend/*.html|*/frontend/*.md) fe="${f%%/frontend/*}/frontend"; (cd "$fe" && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f") ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
